note: Deterministic representative-failure samples for the #218 test baseline. Each entry names a real collected test and a mutation to the committed data it consumes; the sample run intercepts reads/copies of the named path only, so the test fails naturally on its own assertions and the actual pytest diagnostics are recorded in the report's failure_locality.sample section. A mutation that stops provoking a failure fails baseline generation by design.
